description.value: Pallet Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-born specialty coffee roastery and multi-location café chain founded in East Vancouver in 2014, with eight cafes across Metro Vancouver all supplied by its own in-house roastery. The Oak Street location (PALLET OAK) is one of the brand's neighbourhood outposts offering both a full drink menu and food menu including freshly baked goods. The company emphasises direct relationships with farmers and a community-oriented ethos.
